name: Dumbbell Incline Triceps Extension
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie back with feet planted flat.
Extend both dumbbells straight above your shoulders with palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows under control to lower the dumbbells alongside your head.
Straighten both elbows to return the dumbbells back overhead.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed up as your forearms move.
Avoid letting your elbows flare wide and keep your upper arms stationary.
